notes.title: KARATE MASTER 2 – Update 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Karate Master 2: Knock Down Blow - Update v1.1.3

Get ready for a more refined and immersive experience! Here is what’s new in the latest v1.1.3 Update:

Fixes:


 Addressed slowdowns during the underground tournament.
 Added the missing Japanese translation for the Dojo-Kun.
 Oboro's description no longer appears on the map when highlighted with the hand indicator.
 Fixed the heartbeat sound that would persist after leaving a match with trauma.
 Taki_shugyo: Reaching the maximum level now no longer requires additional button mashing.
 Various minor fixes.


New Content & Updates:


 Enhanced flame effects for a more realistic look.
 Kangeiko: Introduced the Master and a new variation of the students.
 Improved water effects for added realism.
 Enhanced and smoother zoom effect.
 Shadow effects have been refined for greater depth.
 Intro backgrounds have been updated for a more impactful presentation.
 Compatibility with Steam Deck has been improved.
 Updated button configuration system for better customization.
 Particle effects have been polished for a sharper visual experience.
 Numerous improvements to the game engine for smoother performance.

notes.title: KARATE MASTER 2 – Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
OSU Guys, 

thanks for all your feedback, the New Update 1.1.1 is ready! 

Update 1.1.1 – Patch Notes

- Key bindings: we have added a new set of key bindings for keyboard controls.
- Keyboard key rollover issue solved. Please go to Key config.
- Key config, we have added two new buttons, they are used to simultaneously press punches (left, right) and kicks (left, right).
- Compatibility with "uncommon" gamepads, is now highly implemented.
- Tameshiwari(baseball), instruction text changed.
- MOKUSO (Status):  Fixed a visualization error, when reached level 10, sometimes it was displayed as 0.
- Some other minor glitches fixed.

We’ll continue to listen the community and give you the best experience with Karate Master 2! 

Crian Soft

notes.title: KARATE MASTER 2 – Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
OSU Guys, 

thanks for all your feedback, we worked to solve the main issues you’re still facing and the Update 1.1.0 is ready! 

Update 1.1.0

- Run as Administrator problem fixed.
- Podiums added a slow zoom effect.
- Oboro stage, now it's possible to rematch the fight.
- Enemy Hiza Geri (occasional miss) fixed.
- Gameplay balance: Now it is more difficult to hit repeatedly in the face with the same technique.

We’ll continue to listen the community and give you the best experience with Karate Master 2!

Crian Soft

notes.title: KARATE MASTER 2 – Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
http://www.criansoft.com/eng/karate%20master%20KDB-2-/Karate_Master_Knock_Down_Blow_2_sshot_26_s.jpg

Hi Guys,

thanks for all your feedback, we’ve worked to solve the main issues you’ve reported in the very first days and the Update 1.0.7 is ready! 

Update 1.0.7 – Patch Notes

- Data.bat crash in specific conditions, fixed.
- Click play nothing happen, fixed.
- Forklift level, if you hit spacebar time decrease to 2, fixed.
- Command Prompt appear instead of launching the game, fixed.
- Options: fullscreen/windowed wording, fixed.
- In some levels the music still plays also if setted to volume zero, fixed.
- Budokan stadium description changed: 70 money instead of 50.
- Tameshiwari (baseball bat), added the instruction: use mawashi geri.
- Now you need to reach 10 to get the achievements: strength,toughness, speed, tai kitae, Ki.
- Improved difficulty balance.

We’ll continue to listen the community and give you the best experience with Karate Master 2!

Milestone Team
